morphir-scala provides Scala bindings and JVM tooling for Morphir.

**AI agents MUST NOT be listed as authors or co-authors of git commits.**
FINOS requires contributors to have a signed CLA; AI agents cannot sign CLAs.
Do NOT use `Co-authored-by:` trailers for AI agents
Do NOT add AI agents to commit author fields
The human developer who reviews and commits the code is the sole author.
This FINOS-wide policy applies to all FINOS projects.

Stack: Scala 3.7.4, Mill 1.1.x, ZIO, ScalaJS, experimental Scala Native.

Layout: `build.mill`; `mill-build/src/` (`millbuild/`); `morphir/` with `src/`, `jvm/src/`, `js/src/`, `contrib/`, `interop/`, `runtime/`, `testing/`, `tools/`; `.config/mise/`; `project/`.
For modules at `morphir/foo/`: `src/` shared; `jvm/src/` JVM; `js/src/` ScalaJS; `src-3/` Scala 3.x; `jvm/src-3.7/` JVM + Scala 3.7.x.

Use mise:
mise run setup
mise run lint
mise run fmt
mise run test:jvm
mise run test:js
mise run ci:local

Or Mill:
./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.compile
./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.test
./mill mill.scalalib.scalafmt.ScalafmtModule/reformatAll 'morphir.__.sources'

Scalafmt 3.10.4, Scala 3 dialect, 120-column width. Run `mise run fmt` before committing. Prefer `given`/`using`, `enum` where appropriate, `derives`, extension methods, `*` imports, `mvn""` (not deprecated `ivy""`), and ZIO libraries. Tests use ZIO Test, `test/src/`, and `ZIOSpecDefault`; run `mise run test:jvm` or `./mill morphir[3.7.4].__.jvm.test`.

Add modules: define in `build.mill` following patterns; create cross-platform source directories; add to `platformSpecificModuleDeps` if needed; update parent dependencies. Check Scala 3.7.4 compatibility, source placement, and deprecated Mill 1.x syntax; run `mise run lint`.

For deterministic builds use `./mill --no-server -j 1`. List targets with `./mill resolve __`; inspect sources with `./mill show <target>.sources`.

GitHub Actions: `lint` (Scalafmt), `test-jvm` (Java 21, 25), `test-js`, `publish` (Sonatype, main/tags only). CI runs on PRs, pushes to main/0.4.x, releases, and manual triggers.

Work is NOT complete until all CI checks pass on the Pull Request.
Monitor with `gh pr checks <pr-number> --watch --interval 30`.
If a check fails, investigate immediately. Do not mark task as done.
Check comments with `gh pr view <pr-number> --json comments,review
